hero.eyebrow: Medical Virtual Assistant for Healthcare Teams
hero.headline: Reliable Medical Documentation Support That Keeps Your Workflow Moving.
hero.subcopy: I support healthcare teams with EHR administration, medical-record request workflows, documentation, and healthcare workflow tracking — so charts stay organized and requests keep moving without pulling your clinical staff off patient care.

problem.headline: Is documentation pulling your team away from patient care?
painPoints: Medical-record requests keep accumulating faster than they can be reviewed.
Staff spend valuable time navigating charts, portals, and request queues.
Legal and insurance record requests require careful, consistent tracking.
Records need to be organized and verified before they can be released.
Scheduling, documentation, and follow-up all compete for the same hours.
Routine EHR work can consume time your clinical staff need elsewhere.
problem.transition: That's where reliable, remote healthcare administrative support can help.

servicesIntro: Support organized around the administrative workflows that take time away from patient care — not a generic task list.

services.title: EHR & Patient Record Support
services.description: Chart review, patient-information updates, encounter documentation, and medical-record organization inside eClinicalWorks.

services.title: Medical Records & Release Workflows
services.description: Tracking medical-record requests from intake through authorized fulfillment — patient verification, service-date checks, and document organization.

services.title: Medical Documentation Support
services.description: Transcription support, documentation review, and structured data entry for patient records and reports.

services.title: Procedure Cost Estimate Preparation
services.description: Verifying patient and procedure information and preparing procedure cost estimate documentation for administrative review — not clinical or pricing decisions.

services.title: Healthcare Workflow Tracking
services.description: Logging and tracking requests, encounters, and record status across shared tracking tools so nothing falls through.

services.title: Coding-Related Administrative Support
services.description: Documentation review and administrative support informed by foundational medical coding training — not certified professional coding.

testimonial.quote: Jimmy has been a dependable part of our documentation workflow. He handles Patient Care Encounter documentation and medical records with a high level of accuracy and organization. His attention to detail helps us maintain clean, audit-ready charts.
testimonial.author: Clinic Documentation Team

whyWorkWithJimmy.headline: Healthcare experience behind the administrative work.
body: Before supporting healthcare teams remotely, I spent over two years in direct hospital patient care — time that shaped how I think about charts, documentation, and the people behind every record.

That clinical foundation carries into the administrative work I do now: I understand why a service date matters, why a chart needs to be complete before a request is released, and why consistency in tracking protects everyone downstream.
points: 2+ years of hospital-based patient care experience
Hands-on experience across EHR, medical-record release, and workflow-tracking systems
Comfortable working within established SOPs and confidentiality expectations
Organized, detail-focused approach to high-volume documentation

process.title: Understand Your Workflow
process.description: Review your systems, priorities, access requirements, and SOPs before any work begins.

process.title: Execute Consistently
process.description: Process documentation, records, and administrative workflows according to your established procedures.

process.title: Review & Report
process.description: Run quality checks, maintain status visibility, and communicate progress clearly.
